The '''2016–17 Serie A''' (known as the [[Serie A]] [[Telecom Italia Mobile|TIM]] for sponsorship reasons) was the 115th season of top-tier Italian [[association football|football]], the 85th in a [[round-robin tournament]], and the 7th since its organization under a league committee separate from [[Serie B]]. [[Juventus FC|Juventus]] were the defending champions. The season ran from 20 August 2016 to 28 May 2017.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.legaseriea.it/uploads/default/attachments/comunicati/comunicati_m/7021/files/allegati/7043/231_-_date_serie_a_tim_2016-2017__tim_cup_2016-2017_e_supercoppa_tim_2017.pdf|title=Date di calendario per la stagione sportiva 2016/2017|language=it|date=17 May 2016|publisher=Lega Serie A|access-date=19 May 2016|archive-date=27 May 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160527191224/http://www.legaseriea.it/uploads/default/attachments/comunicati/comunicati_m/7021/files/allegati/7043/231_-_date_serie_a_tim_2016-2017__tim_cup_2016-2017_e_supercoppa_tim_2017.pdf|url-status=dead}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.football-italia.net/84468/serie-kicks-august-20?|title=Serie A kicks off August 20|date=17 May 2016|publisher=Football Italia}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.gazzetta.it/Calcio/Serie-A/17-05-2016/serie-2016-17-via-21-agosto-3-turni-infrasettimanali-si-chiude-28-maggio-150705539094.shtml|title=Serie A 2016-17: via il 21 agosto, 3 turni infrasettimanali, si chiude il 28 maggio|publisher=gazzetta.it|date=17 May 2016|language=it}}</ref>

On 21 May, Juventus won a record sixth consecutive title and 33rd title overall with a game in hand following their 3–0 win over [[F.C. Crotone|Crotone]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/39926308 |title=Juventus 3–0 Crotone|date=21 May 2017|work=BBC Sport|access-date=25 October 2017}}</ref>

==Events==
On 14 April 2016, it was announced that Serie A was selected by the [[International Football Association Board]] to test [[video assistant referee]]ing, which were initially private for the 2016–17 season, before allowing them to become a live pilot phase with replay assistance in the 2017–18 season at the latest. On the decision, FIGC President [[Carlo Tavecchio]] said, "We were among the first supporters of using technology on the pitch and we believe we have everything required to offer our contribution to this important experiment."<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.sportsnet.ca/soccer/serie-selected-ifab-test-video-replay/|title=Serie A selected by IFAB to test video replay|publisher=sportsnet.ca|date=14 April 2016|access-date=17 April 2016}}</ref>

On 29 April 2016, [[F.C. Crotone|Crotone]] earned their first ever promotion to Serie A.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.espnfc.us/crotone/story/2861334/crotone-promoted-to-serie-a-for-first-time-in-their-history|title=Crotone promoted to Serie A for first time in their history|publisher=espnfc.com|date=29 April 2016|access-date=1 May 2016}}</ref> One week later, [[Cagliari Calcio|Cagliari]] was also promoted after just one year in [[2015–16 Serie B|Serie B]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.football-italia.net/83938/cagliari-back-serie|title=Cagliari back in Serie A!|date=6 May 2016|work=football-italia.net}}</ref> On 9 June 2016, [[Delfino Pescara 1936|Pescara]] won the [[2015–16 Serie B|Serie B play-off]] to return to Serie A after a 3-year absence.<ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.gazzetta.it/Calcio/Serie-A/30-06-2016/ecco-arbitri-serie-2016-17-promosso-luca-pairetto-nichelino-figlio-pierluigi-calciopoli-maresca-napoli-160173914651.shtml|title=Ecco gli arbitri della serie A 2016-17: c'è il figlio di Pairetto, e Maresca di Napoli|author=Francesco Ceniti|publisher=gazzetta.it|language=it|date=30 June 2016}}</ref>

On 13 April 2017, historical [[A.C. Milan|Milan]] president [[Silvio Berlusconi]] sold the ownership of the club to Chinese-born, Luxembourg-based [[Rossoneri Sport Investment Lux]], with [[Li Yonghong]] as representing acting chairman.<ref>{{cite web|title=AC Milan: finalizzata la cessione del 99,9% del club da Fininvest alla Rossoneri Sport Investment Lux|language=it|publisher=Fininvest
|url=http://www.fininvest.it/assets/press/it/CS%20CONGIUNTO_closing%20Milan_13.4.17.pdf}}</ref> The former [[Prime Minister of Italy|Prime Minister]] left the club after 31 years and 29 trophies.

On 28 May 2017, [[Francesco Totti]], [[AS Roma]] legendary footballer, played his last match against [[Genoa C.F.C.|Genoa]].
